changes.title: White Sands footprints suggest humans experienced abrupt environmental shifts during the last ice age
changes.summary: Expanded excavations at White Sands National Park in New Mexico have provided researchers an opportunity to refine the age of the oldest human footprints in North America and establish a deeper understanding of the landscape and environmental conditions at the time humans were present there.

changes.title: How did Earth get its water? Inside the extreme machine seeking answers
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 30 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02978-4 The Z machine in New Mexico generates shockwaves that can simulate conditions deep inside our planet.

changes.title: Instagram owner Meta ordered to pay nearly $1B in fines for risking child safety, court says
changes.summary: Meta, the parent company of Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and others, must pay nearly $1 billion after a court found the social media giant to have put children and teen users at risk. A New Mexico judge ruled that Meta must pay $567 million into a fund to pay for harm prevention and awareness, in addition to $375 mill.
